mechanics.claim: Jinx gains attack speed stacks up to 5 that grant 25% total attack speed each, exceeding the normal attack speed cap, increasing her damage output over time in a sustained fight.
mechanics.quote: she also gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus total''' attack speed}}}} and is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap

mechanics.claim: The attack speed cap is raised to 90.0 for the duration of the buff.
mechanics.quote: '''Jinx's''' ''attack speed cap'' is increased to {{fd|90.0}} for the duration

mechanics.claim: Only champion takedowns grant additional stacks beyond the first; the buff is triggered by takedowns of champions, epic monsters, turrets, or inhibitors.
mechanics.quote: Only {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} can grant stacks beyond the first.

mechanics.claim: The movement speed granted decays over the 6 second duration rather than being a flat bonus.
